topic: How do satellite antenna feed spacing and propagation path length constraints affect power consumption in LOS environments?
consensus_response: Increased feed spacing widens beamwidth, reducing directivity and increasing interference due to adjacent beams' overlap. This necessitates adaptive beamforming (ABF) to optimize satellite antenna performance in LOS environments, mitigating the effects of feed spacing and propagation path length constraints on power consumption. Reduced free space gain due to propagation path length constraint increases transmitted power, further exacerbating interference and reducing capacity.
